user.title: Coop Schweiz – sign in
user.description:
1. Open the sign-in page in a browser **on a computer** (not on the phone, otherwise the Coop app takes over the sign-in) and sign in with your Supercard ID:

[Open the Supercard ID sign-in]({auth_url})

2. After signing in you land on an error page. That is expected. Copy its **full address** from the address bar (it contains `code=`) and paste it below right away. The code is only valid for a short time.

data_description.redirect_url: The complete address of the page shown after signing in.

reauth_confirm.title: Coop Schweiz – sign in again
reauth_confirm.description:
The sign-in has expired. Open the sign-in page in a browser **on a computer** and sign in with the same Supercard ID:

[Open the Supercard ID sign-in]({auth_url})

Then copy the **full address** of the error page (it contains `code=`) and paste it below right away.

data_description.redirect_url: The complete address of the page shown after signing in.

error.auth: The sign-in was rejected or the code has expired. Open the link again and paste the fresh address right away.
error.invalid_code: No code found in the address. Copy the full address of the page shown after signing in.
error.wrong_state: This address belongs to another sign-in attempt. Use the link shown in this dialog.
error.cannot_connect: The Coop servers could not be reached. Please try again later.
error.api_error: The Coop servers returned an unexpected answer. See the log for details.
error.no_lists: No shopping list found on this account. Create one in the Coop app first.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This list is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: This Supercard ID has no access to the list of this entry. Sign in with the account used before.

auth_failed.message: The Coop sign-in has expired. Please sign in again.

item_gone.message: This product no longer exists on the Coop list.

communication_error.message: The Coop list could not be changed: {error}

catalog_rename.message: Products from the Coop catalogue cannot be renamed. Only the quantity can be changed.

product_not_found.message: No product with the number {code} was found in the Coop catalogue.

add_product.name: Add Coop product
add_product.description: Adds a product of the Coop catalogue by its product number. Such products are known to the Coop app and the Passabene self-scanner.
